import sys
import click
import pytest
from click.testing import CliRunner


@pytest.fixture
def runner():
    return CliRunner()


def test_missing_required_flag(runner):
    @click.command()
    @click.option("--foo", is_flag=True, required=True)
    def cmd(foo):
        click.echo(foo)

    result = runner.invoke(cmd, [])
    assert result.exit_code == 2
    assert "Error: Missing option '--foo'." in result.output

    result = runner.invoke(cmd, ["--foo"])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert result.output == "True\n"


def test_missing_required_flag_bool_pair(runner):
    @click.command()
    @click.option("--foo/--no-foo", required=True)
    def cmd(foo):
        click.echo(foo)

    result = runner.invoke(cmd, [])
    assert result.exit_code == 2
    assert "Error: Missing option '--foo / --no-foo'." in result.output

    result = runner.invoke(cmd, ["--no-foo"])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert result.output == "False\n"

    click.echo("hello")

    click.echo(b"bytes")
    click.echo()
